title: Naturally Crisp Uruguayan Potato Buns Burger
description: A festive Uruguayan dish featuring crispy potato buns, binchotan-charcoal grilled beef, and ayurvedic-rajasic friendly ingredients, this burger is perfect for a summer evening, the earthy flavors of the potato buns and the charcoal grilled beef make for a delicious combination.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat using the binchotan charcoal.
Boil the potatoes until they are tender, then mash and let cool.
Mix the cooled mashed potatoes with a pinch of salt and shape into buns.
Brush the potato buns with olive oil and grill until crispy and golden brown.
Grill the ground beef until it is cooked to the desired level of doneness.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a slice of tomato on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked beef patty, a few slices of onion, a sprinkle of lettuce, and finally the top bun.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
